thesis.text: Quarterly revenue for the quarter ended 2026-06-30 was USD 188.22 billion on the provider's basis; more precisely the provider figure is 188,219,000 USD, and it grew 97.95% year over year, so the growth trajectory is strong even on the lower of two unreconciled revenue definitions (judgment: the revenue definitions differ, so growth is read directionally).
thesis.label: FACT
